_comment: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals quarterly overrides. Mix of issues: ARPOB sometimes captured at 100x scale, operational beds sometimes per-hospital (300) instead of network total (~1061), revenue/EBITDA/PAT mostly correct from concall extractions. Override the 4 latest quarters which dominate dashboard view.

revenue.note: Q4 FY26 revenue from operations, INR Cr
